label: fn_oq5e_replacement
question: Does the plain oQ5e serve on this 128GB machine, and how does it compare to the retired oQ4e?

build.vs_oq4e: same 8-bit shared experts; routed MoE experts lifted 4->5 bit; hyper-connections to 6-bit

load_alone.note: PLE offloaded to SSD; this is the compute-weight residency

serve_alone.detail: trivial prompt (~40 tokens, max_tokens=200) aborted mid-prefill: usage 102.9 GB vs hard watermark 102.1 GB, metal_cap 107.52 GB
serve_alone.meaning: cannot generate a single token, ALONE, under the default iogpu.wired_limit_mb

coexistence.detail: projected 139-140 GB (lineup ~51 GB committed + model 88.15 GB) exceeds metal_cap 107.52 GB

candidate_gate.detail: gate checks bundled mlx_lm/models/qwen4_exp.py which is absent; oMLX runs this arch via its vendored qwen4_exp runtime, so the gate cannot evaluate coexistence for Flash-Next

comparison_oq4e.reading: the +22 GB disk / +25 GB resident from 4->5 bit erases the ~33 GB KV headroom oQ4e had; oQ5e crosses the hard watermark on prefill alone

verdict: REJECT before benchmarking quality: the plain oQ5e does not serve on this 128GB machine even alone. No decode/quality numbers are obtainable without raising iogpu.wired_limit_mb, which FINDINGS §H documents as thrashing/kernel-panic territory.
